answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the wander funding graph is rebuilt from the garden history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 348 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator forfeits 348 bonds yet holds one position, and the zenith report publishes the merged exposure. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
